stem: When coordinating care for a transplant recipient with an infected surgical wound, which wound-management principle aligns with standard bacterial-infection references?

options.text: Wound treatment varies based on wound type, depth, drainage, progression of granulation tissue, and location
All wound infections are managed identically regardless of depth or drainage
Wound care never considers granulation tissue progression
Antibiotics alone replace all local wound management in every case

explanation.rationale_correct: Wound infection management includes appropriate antibiotics based on culture and sensitivities, with wound treatment varying by wound type, extent and depth, drainage, progression of granulation tissue, and location.

rationale_incorrect.B: Wound management is individualized rather than identical for all infections.
rationale_incorrect.C: Granulation tissue progression is among factors guiding wound treatment.
rationale_incorrect.D: Local wound care is individualized in addition to antibiotics rather than being replaced by antibiotics alone in every case.

primary_anchor.section: Ch. 13, Post-Transplant Complications → bacterial infection → Treatment → h.iv.
primary_anchor.quote_hint: Wound treatment varies based on type of wound, extent and depth, amount of drainage, progression of granulation tissue, and location

stem: A lung transplant recipient with bacterial pneumonia is being monitored on the unit. Which nursing intervention aligns with standard references?

options.text: Reposition the patient every 2 hours and encourage activity if ambulatory
Keep the patient in one position continuously to conserve energy
Discourage coughing and deep breathing to prevent fatigue
Oxygen saturation monitoring is unnecessary during bacterial pneumonia

explanation.rationale_correct: Bacterial pneumonia management includes auscultation for respiratory changes, inhalation or percussive therapy, encouraging deep breathing and coughing, monitoring supplemental oxygen, and repositioning every 2 hours with activity when ambulatory.

rationale_incorrect.B: Repositioning every 2 hours is recommended rather than maintaining one position continuously.
rationale_incorrect.C: Deep breathing and coughing are encouraged rather than discouraged.
rationale_incorrect.D: Oxygen saturation and supplemental oxygen are monitored during respiratory infection.

stem: When managing a central venous line (CVL) infection in a transplant recipient, which monitoring step aligns with standard references?

options.text: Draw blood cultures daily until negative
Blood cultures are obtained only once at diagnosis and never repeated
CVL infections never require blood cultures
Daily cultures continue indefinitely even after documented clearance

explanation.rationale_correct: Central venous line infection management includes appropriate antimicrobial therapy based on culture and sensitivities, with blood cultures drawn daily until negative and treatment usually continuing for 10 to 14 days from the first negative culture.

rationale_incorrect.B: Daily blood cultures until negative are specifically recommended rather than a single culture only.
rationale_incorrect.C: Blood cultures are part of CVL infection monitoring and management.
rationale_incorrect.D: Cultures are followed until negative with defined treatment duration rather than continuing indefinitely without clinical indication.

stem: A coordinator is updating central venous line (CVL) infection protocols. Evaluate the following statements:

elements.text: Appropriate antimicrobial medications should be given based on culture and sensitivities.
Blood cultures should be drawn daily until negative.
Removal of the CVL may be necessary.
CVL infections never require line removal or exchange under any circumstances.

explanation.rationale_correct: Sensitivity-guided antimicrobials, daily cultures until negative, and possible CVL removal are supported. Statement IV is false because CVL removal or exchange over a guide wire may be necessary.

rationale_incorrect.A: Statement III is also true—CVL removal may be necessary in some cases.
rationale_incorrect.C: Statement I is also true; statement IV is false.
rationale_incorrect.D: Statement IV is false because line removal or exchange may be required.
